newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire flat sale response "enthusiastic".
newsitem.headline: Swire flat sale response "enthusiastic".

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd has received an "enthusiastic reponse" to its Island Place flats pre-sale, with 160 applications registered on Tuesday, said Maisie Shun Wah, manager of group public affairs at John Swire & Sons.
"Yesterday we had 160 people registered to buy," she said. "We feel that there was a very enthusiastic reponse there."
Registration for the sale of 48 residential units at Swire's Island Place property development in Hong Kong's North Point district began on Tuesday and will end on Friday.
Flat selection will be on September 16.
Prices range from about HK$5,200 per sq ft to about HK$7,000 per sq ft, giving an average HK$6,282 per sq ft, Shun Wah said.

"We also found that a lot of the people who registered yesterday are genuine buyers mainly because they actually put in only one application. Another thing is they registered under their own name," Shun Wah said.
Island Place is a residential and commercial development jointly owned by Swire and China Motor Bus Co Ltd.
Swire Pacific shares were up HK$1.00 at HK$68.50 in late-morning trade and China Motor Bus rose HK$0.25 to HK$78.00.
